subject: Appeal: Senior SWE candidate banding — evidence & offer timing
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Tanya Ruiz <tanya.ruiz@talenthunt.com>, Alex Garrity <alex.garrity@fidgetco.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: [Appeal] Candidate banding: Alex Garrity (Senior vs Staff) — attached evidence

Hi Monica / Marcus,

Following up on the panel outcome for Alex Garrity (SWE candidate sourced via Tanya). Marcus flagged concerns about the panel banding Alex at Senior while Marcus believes Alex meets our Staff criteria. This candidate has another live offer and we need clarity to move the process forward.

I've attached the resume and the panel notes we received. Marcus, can you please outline the specific evidence that supports a Staff banding (concrete interview snippets, reference feedback, or matrix scores)? Monica — can you confirm the rubric applied and whether a calibration is available this week? Candidate is asking for timeline.

Quick asks:
- Marcus: give the strongest 3 datapoints that justify Staff (e.g., system design outcome, cross-team impact examples, reference quote).
- Monica: summarize the rubric decision (who applied it) and whether we can escalate to a calibration panel.
- Neha: if we escalate, can we fast-track compensation approval if band changes?

Attachments: Alex_Garrity_resume.pdf, panel_notes_20260830.pdf

Thanks — want to avoid losing the candidate.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Eng Hiring Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Appeal] Candidate banding: Alex Garrity (Senior vs Staff) — attached evidence

Hi Olga / Marcus — thanks for the note.

Summary of where this landed: the interviewing panel (4 interviewers) scored Alex consistently high on algorithmic problem solving and mid-to-high on system design; however, two panelists flagged product scope and org-wide influence as not yet demonstrated. Per our leveling rubric, that weighted down the aggregate band to Senior. The rubric and scores are attached (panel_notes_20260830.pdf).

We can escalate to a calibration panel (Hiring Council) but that requires:
- clear evidence from the hiring manager on impact and cross-org ownership
- consolidated interview notes (one-pager)
- approval to pull an ad-hoc Hiring Council this week (I can coordinate)

If Marcus can provide the three strongest items you mentioned, I will submit a request for a calibration slot. Note that compensation approval for a higher band requires People Director sign-off — Neha, tagging you to confirm timeline if calibration moves to Staff.

Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations (Hiring & Compensation)
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Appeal] Candidate banding: Alex Garrity (Senior vs Staff) — attached evidence

Monica / Olga,

Thanks for coordinating. Below are the three concrete datapoints I want the council to consider for Staff (with short evidence bullets):

1) Cross-team product leadership
- Led design and rollout of an availability SLA system at his previous employer that touched infra, platform, and billing teams; owners report measurable reduction in incidents (ref: panel note 3, reference call from Priya at BitStork).

2) System design depth and tradeoff ownership
- In design interview, candidate proposed an event-sourcing approach with multi-region considerations; produced measurable cost/latency tradeoffs and ops-ability plan (interviewer J. Ortiz noted strong ownership).

3) Mentorship and org-level influence
- Ran quarterly technical brown-bags and was the technical lead for two cross-team initiatives; referees described him as the "go-to" for critical architectural decisions.

Additional context: coding interview metrics were in the 95th percentile; design was within top decile for candidates we've hired at Staff in the last 12 months. I am attaching a draft offer sheet (offer_sheet_FidgetCo_v1.pdf) with proposed comp band and sign-on — if council approves rebanding to Staff, we need People sign-off ASAP, candidate has an external deadline (9/6).

Request: Please escalate to the Hiring Council this week and mark this as time-sensitive. If council agrees, Neha — can you provisionally reserve the comp band for Staff until final sign-off?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: [Appeal] Candidate banding: Alex Garrity (Senior vs Staff) — attached evidence

Team — quick update and action items.

Thanks Marcus for the clear evidence set and the draft offer. Monica, please proceed with a Hiring Council escalation; ask for the earliest slot and label as "urgent: candidate deadline 2026-09-06". Include Marcus's three datapoints and the attached panel notes when you submit.

Neha — please provisionally hold Staff comp band for this candidate and advise on whether we can extend a conditional offer pending council outcome (language to protect us if we revert to Senior). If we need a temporary authorization code for comp, let me know and I'll approve the paperwork.

Tanya / Alex (cc'd) — we understand this is taking longer than ideal. Marcus and People are working to get a final assessment this week. We may be able to provide a conditional timeline by 9/3 and a formal decision by 9/5. If your external offer deadline is earlier, please flag.

Attachments: offer_sheet_FidgetCo_v1.pdf

I'll follow up once Monica confirms the council slot.

Best,
Olga Petrov
